name: seattle-building-permit-completion
description: Will a newly issued Seattle building permit for a substantive construction project reach final inspection sign-off within four years of issuance?
split_description: Fixed calendar boundaries on IssuedDate, no shuffling: train = 2016-01-01..2018-12-31 (11,289 eligible permits), eval = 2019-01-01..2020-12-31 (7,135), holdout = 2021-01-01..2022-09-30 (6,326). The holdout end date is chosen so the last 48-month label window closes on 2026-09-30, before the 2026-11-14 snapshot. No embargo is applied or needed: every feature is strictly row-local, there are no lags, rolling aggregates or other permits' outcomes, so moving a boundary by a month cannot leak anything.
